payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance whose open combat ends, when the command names no target; never written. Nothing else is sent: the command lands on the open combat's own row and writes its endedAt, now, and its currentEntryId, null — no turn is anyone's. Its tokens, their HP and their conditions, and its entries, stay as they are; a new combat may start once it ended (one-active-combat). An instance with no open combat is refused
